decisions.reason: As a homepage-promoted extension of the core cloud messaging offer in a growing market, it is a strategically important option whose uncertainty is still too unresolved after only one year to justify abandonment.

Because it has its own page and fits the firm's electronic document workflow direction, management would keep this adjacent option open while market learning continues and retention costs are likely modest relative to its potential.
This service builds on existing messaging and fax capabilities, so it is relatively cheap to maintain and still worth keeping as an option until demand becomes clearer.
As a close-to-core optimization feature for fax delivery, it likely requires limited incremental resources and should be retained while the firm evaluates customer uptake.
Threat protection is highly consistent with the firm's secure communications positioning, so management would preserve this security option rather than exit before its value is fully revealed.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a close complement to the existing secure email stack and, given low expected continuation cost and ongoing uncertainty, it should remain on the market.
